required_attribution: Contains information from Friendly Buildings accessed 18 Oct 2026 from data.gov.sg, made available under the Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0 https://developers.data.gov.sg/open-data-licence
dataset_temporal_scope: Data from Mar 2019; dataset updated 18 Apr 2026 according to data.gov.sg. Coordinates can be older than publication/version update.
workbook_path: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
match_method: Exact six-digit postal join; require one unique source coordinate per postal; normalize to uppercase alphanumeric tokens, strip Address prefix, country, six-digit postal, unit/level and block annotations; require the complete normalized BCA source street/address line, including street/address number, as a contiguous substring of workbook Full Address. No fuzzy street-name or number substitutions.
coordinate_semantics: Building/facility-level source point only; not storefront/stall-front coordinates. Exact address match helps identify the building, not the outlet unit.
coordinate_precision_recommended: BCA Friendly Buildings building/facility point; exact postal plus exact normalized street/address-number match; not stall-front precision; source data from Mar 2019.
source_freshness_risk: data.gov.sg reports Friendly Buildings data from Mar 2019 and dataset metadata refreshed later. Building coordinates are usually geographically stable but the vintage does not verify current outlet/stall position. Store source vintage and precision explicitly; prefer a current official building/locator coordinate if available.
